purpose: Diagnose failed Stage5 C3 before any L7 run; no retraining and no target-label tuning.
rules: Do not rerun Stage1-4 or retrain Stage5 students.
Correct Stage5 diagnostic coordinates to use the v0.11 global ancestor-norm normalization; note that positive column rescaling does not change NNLS cone residuals.
Learn any cross-scale transfer only from paired 4B-base/1.7B-base anchor IFRFs, excluding the evaluated probe set.
Select ridge strength only by internal cross-validation on anchor pairs; do not use KD target responses, support labels, or construction weights for tuning.
All corrected/transfer variants are diagnostic G1 analyses and do not inherit matched-G0 finite-sample guarantees.
Teacher exposure weights remain diagnostic construction metadata, not functional-coordinate ground truth.
